proposed.text: A warehouse (600 sqm) requires lighting load per PEC 220.12 (warehouse = 1 VA/sqm). The warehouse also has 10 receptacles at 180 VA each and one 2 kW three-phase motor for material handling. What is the total connected load before demand factors?
proposed.rationale: Connected load = lighting + receptacles + motor (no demand factor applied). Lighting = 600 sqm x 1 VA/sqm = 600 VA. Receptacles = 10 x 180 VA = 1,800 VA. Motor = 2 kW = 2,000 VA. Total = 600 + 1,800 + 2,000 = 4,400 VA. The original '4,600 VA' answer over-counted by 200 VA. Source: PEC 220.12 (general lighting unit load) and receptacle/motor nameplate provisions.
proposed.explanation: Total connected load = 600 + 1,800 + 2,000 = 4,400 VA before any demand factor.
